guidance.metric_label: FY27 revenue at least double FY26
guidance.condition: CMD added 'It'll be much more than double.' FY26 revenue ₹583 Cr; depends on fleet growing from 2-3 to 5 narrow-bodies plus wide-bodies
guidance.quote: And as the resources, even it becomes double, you can extrapolate it's going to be minimum double.
guidance.speaker: Kannan Ramakrishnan (Whole-time Director)

guidance.metric_label: 4th and 5th 737 freighters operational before next quarter
guidance.quote: Sir, all I would say is that they will be operational, the third aircraft is operational, fourth and fifth will be operational definitely before the next quarter.
guidance.speaker: Capt. Deepak Parasuraman (Chairman & MD)
guidance.keyword: fourth and fifth will be operational

guidance.metric_label: First Boeing 777 freighter operating by Q4 FY27
guidance.condition: Four 777s planned and financially closed; full nine-aircraft fleet by second half of CY2027
guidance.quote: By the end of the calendar year, this year, it will be inducted, so at least one aircraft will be operational by the end of FY27 last quarter.
guidance.speaker: Capt. Deepak Parasuraman (Chairman & MD)

guidance.metric_label: Full fleet of nine aircraft by H2 CY2027
guidance.quote: Sometime by the mid of next year, sir. That is the second half of next calendar year, we will have the entire fleet operational.
guidance.speaker: Capt. Deepak Parasuraman (Chairman & MD)

guidance.metric_label: Each 777 to earn ~3x a 737's revenue (~₹75 Cr a month)
guidance.condition: Management confirmed ~₹75 Cr a month per 777 as 'a very conservative estimate' (p.25)
guidance.quote: So given that and the sectors what we plan to operate on, and with the cargo load factor taken conservatively as 75%, we estimate each of the aircraft, the 777 will provide an average the revenue of three times from the current level of the 737-800's the revenue -- recorded revenue.
guidance.speaker: Kannan Ramakrishnan (Whole-time Director)

guidance.metric_label: No further fund-raise needed for the fleet plan
guidance.condition: ~₹205 Cr preferential issue (Dec 2025) and ₹200 Cr QIP (May 2026)
guidance.quote: So we don't require any further, you know, the fundraise, you know, for the fleet expansion whatever we have envisaged and communicated.
guidance.speaker: Kannan Ramakrishnan (Whole-time Director)

guidance.metric_label: ATF VAT benefit cuts fuel cost 5-7%
guidance.quote: As I mentioned, sir, I mean, it will have an impact of, close to around 5% to 7% on an overall cost of the fuel.
guidance.speaker: Kannan Ramakrishnan (Whole-time Director)

insights.summary: FY26 revenue rose 144% to ₹583 Cr and PAT 230% to ₹122 Cr (40% EBITDA margin) on just two Boeing 737 freighters, helped in March by charter demand when the Middle East war stranded cargo; it was the first year under Ind AS, which brought aircraft leases on balance sheet. Management says FY27 revenue will be 'minimum double' as the fleet grows to five 737s (fourth and fifth 'before the next quarter') and the first of four Boeing 777 freighters flies by Q4 FY27, each expected to earn about three times a 737. Earlier FY26 targets of ₹1,000 Cr, then ₹700 Cr, were missed because aircraft arrived late.

what_changed.text: FY27 revenue to at least double
FY26 revenue ₹583 Cr vs ₹1,000 Cr target (cut to ₹700 Cr at the AGM)
Four Boeing 777 freighters financed; first operating by Q4 FY27
Designated Indian Carrier status: ATF VAT exemption saves 5-7% of fuel cost
First freighter into Noida airport; Middle East contract flying from end-June

tone.label: confident
tone.quote: Sir, to put it in brief, sir, the demand is high, we are short of capacity.

analyst_questions.answer: Only two aircraft for most of the year; numbers will follow as capacity arrives.
Fuel surcharge passes 100% to customers; VAT exemption brought ATF to ₹1.69 lakh/KL vs ₹2.24 lakh.
Third aircraft held back after C-check for a large Middle East contract from end-June.
Advance tax was underpaid; will improve this year.

red_flags.text: FY26 revenue missed targets twice because of fleet delays.
March quarter boosted by one-off war charters; yields may normalise.
₹33 Cr of income tax unpaid at year end, attracting interest.
Lease liabilities ₹338 Cr and USD-linked costs; Ind AS forex losses hit Q4.
Promoters' stake has fallen to ~36% after repeated equity issues.

business_snapshot.what_they_make: International air cargo airline flying Boeing 737-800 freighters on dry-lease and charter, hub at Chennai
business_snapshot.customers: Freight forwarders (DHL, Kuehne+Nagel, DSV, DB Schenker, Geodis) via GSSA TTK Group; airline interline partners
business_snapshot.revenue_mix: FY26: dry-lease flying ₹529 Cr; 1,923 trips, 59% charters; >60% billed in USD
business_snapshot.demand_drivers: India-ASEAN-Middle East trade, shortage of freighter capacity, transshipment via Chennai, war-related disruption
